description: Quantized GEMM processing element for LLM inference. Prefer mixed INT4/INT8 datapaths, bounded multiplier usage, and simple pipelined MAC structure.

metrics.downstream_score: lower is better; combines multiplier budget, preferred bitwidth detection, Yosys JSON netlist structure, and pipeline hints
metrics.multiplier_count: Yosys JSON multiplier cell count when available, otherwise number of '*' operators in generated RTL
metrics.preferred_bitwidth_hits: count of preferred quantized bitwidth patterns detected
metrics.pipeline_register_blocks: posedge always blocks as a simple source-level pipeline proxy
metrics.mul_cells: multiplier-like cells parsed from Yosys JSON netlist
metrics.add_cells: adder/subtractor-like cells parsed from Yosys JSON netlist
metrics.dff_cells: flip-flop-like cells parsed from Yosys JSON netlist
metrics.mux_cells: mux-like cells parsed from Yosys JSON netlist
metrics.estimated_mac_lanes: min(mul_cells, add_cells) as a GEMM/MAC lane proxy
metrics.pipeline_depth_proxy: DFF-to-MAC-lane ratio as a lightweight pipeline depth proxy
metrics.area_delay_product_proxy: weighted area proxy times structural delay proxy from Yosys JSON cells
